name: nginx-multisite
description: Configures Nginx as a reverse proxy and web server for three SSL-enabled virtual hosts, including static content, security headers, TLS certificates, fail2ban, UFW, sysctl tuning, and SSH hardening.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys a Python FastAPI tutorial application from Git, including its virtual environment, dependencies, PostgreSQL database and user, environment configuration, and Uvicorn systemd service.

name: cache
description: Manages cache services, including Memcached and Redis installation, configuration, service management, logging, and Redis authentication settings.
